无懈可击•国: Before a Tool card takes effect on a player whose General is exposed, negates its effect on every player of that player's Kingdom; or negates the effects of another Negate.
以逸待劳: Play Phase: use on yourself and every other player of your Kingdom. Each target draws two cards and then discards two cards (in hand or equipped), starting with you and going on in turn order.
知己知彼: Play Phase: use on another player. Choose one: look at one of their hidden General cards, or look at all of their hand cards. If both their General cards are exposed, you can only look at their hand. Recast: instead of using it, put this card into the discard pile and draw 1 card; this is neither using nor discarding it.
远交近攻: Play Phase: use on a player of a different Kingdom who has an exposed General. That player draws a card, then you draw three cards.
三尖两刃刀: After your Slash deals damage to a target, you may discard a hand card and choose another player at distance 1 from that target. That player takes 1 damage. If you are at distance 1 from the target, you may choose yourself.
吴六剑: Compulsory: you and every other player of your Kingdom have your attack range increased by 1.
